claims.statement: For a rational recognizable series with minimal realization dimension r, realization entry height H, and a jointly strictly upper-triangular rational query of dimension D and entry height B, each response denominator divides Q*=q_lambda q_gamma(q_A q_X)^(D-1), with log2 Q* <= 2rH+(D-1)(nr^2H+nD^2B). Nearest fixed-point rounding with p>=2 ceil(log2 Q*)+2 fractional bits allows exact entrywise continued-fraction reconstruction and deterministic adaptive transcript simulation, subject to explicit query-generation and learner costs.
assumptions: Rational realization and supplied bounds H, B, r, n, D
Every query tuple is jointly strictly upper triangular
Rounded oracle guarantees deterministic absolute error <=2^(-p-1) per entry
Adaptive query generation is bit-computable from reconstructed rational history
claims.status: INTERNALLY_DERIVED_CYCLE2_CANDIDATE; STANDARD RATIONAL RECONSTRUCTION; PRIORITY NOT CLEARED
claims.novelty_boundary: Continued-fraction rational reconstruction is classical. The local result is the explicit denominator/height calculation for the finite nilpotent evaluation and the charged transcript compiler. It neither validates L01 nor gives numerical stability for arbitrary characteristic-zero targets.

costs.returned_entries: D^2 per query, T D^2 total
costs.reconstruction_runtime: O(D^2(p+hmag+h*)^2) schoolbook bit operations per query
costs.local_evaluator_if_realization_known: O(nr^2D^2+r^3D^4) rational operations, with intermediate bit length O(D(h_A+h_X+H+B+log(nrD))+h_lambda+h_gamma)
costs.hidden_dimension: r<=m supplied; query dimension D charged

claims.falsifier: A legal rational query response whose reduced denominator does not divide Q*, or a reconstruction collision under the stated error and denominator bounds.
claims.next_gate: Independent algebra review and a finite exact-versus-rounded adaptive transcript implementation.

claims.statement: For T adaptive queries of dimension at most D, independent Gaussian entry noise N(0,sigma^2), and bounded rational responses with denominator at most Q*, s>=32 sigma^2 Q*^4 ln(4TD^2/delta) repetitions per exact query suffice for exact transcript reconstruction with failure at most delta after digital quantization/clipping as specified. This is a sufficient uniform cost, not a necessary consequence of denominator separation alone.
assumptions: Independent Gaussian noise on each scalar entry and repeated calls allowed
Known common denominator and magnitude bounds Q*, 2^hmag
Adaptive query is issued only after the preceding response is reconstructed
Digital bit costs use the explicit quantize-and-clip adapter; ideal real outputs have no finite bit count
claims.novelty_boundary: Gaussian concentration, union bounds, clipping, and rational reconstruction are standard; this is an explicit finite-interface accounting, not a new statistical principle.

costs.clip_range: R=2^hmag+sigma sqrt(2 ln(4N/delta)), N=T s D^2
costs.returned_bits: T s D^2 times bits per scalar sample
costs.query_input_bits: s L_X per query if retransmitted; L_X plus charged protocol overhead if cached
costs.runtime: O(sD^2 b_G) accumulation plus O(D^2(b_G+h*+hmag)^2) reconstruction per query
costs.excitation: Each repeat pays the per-call cap; cumulative repeat opportunity is sE

claims.falsifier: An error probability above delta under the stated independent Gaussian and adapter model at the stated repetitions would contradict the tail-and-union-bound proof.
claims.next_gate: Compare against structured decoders or larger response margins before treating this sufficient cost as tight.

claims.statement: For hidden-word series f_w(u)=1[u=w] of minimal rank d+1, Gaussian testing of zero versus every a f_w under per-query aggregate excitation E has expected total query dimension under the null at least 2 sigma^2 a^(-2)(n/E)^d kl(1-delta,delta). In addition, comparing (1/q)f_w and (1/(q+1))f_w for a fixed word gives a Q^4 Gaussian testing lower bound with Q=q+1 response-denominator scale and E=1: C>=2 sigma^2 q^2(q+1)^2 kl(1-delta,delta).
assumptions: Every query obeys sum_i X_i^T X_i <= E I
All entries of each returned matrix have independent Gaussian noise of variance sigma^2
Cost C is expected total query dimension under the stated base hypothesis
Testing errors are at most delta for each hypothesis
claims.status: INTERNALLY_RECONSTRUCTED_FROM-ENERGY-AND-ADAPTIVE-KL ARGUMENT; N25 SOURCE PROOF AND PRIORITY UNVERIFIED
claims.novelty_boundary: Scoped interface lower bounds only. The Q^4 result is proved from an adjacent-amplitude testing pair and the excitation/KL inequality; it is not inferred from rational denominator separation and is not a general automata-learning novelty claim.

costs.returned_entries: At least the corresponding dimension cost because D^2>=D

claims.falsifier: An adaptive strategy meeting the stated testing errors with expected dimension below the corresponding inequality under the same channel and excitation assumptions.
claims.next_gate: Retrieve and independently audit the full N25 proof package and search specifically for this matrix-evaluation/excitation interface.
